7.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_TALK_A7
7.description: What are tomes of regional folklore?

9.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_000
9.description: Certain wealthy individuals value items not for their potential applications, but for an intrinsic quality we have taken to calling “collectability.”

10.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_001
10.description: Rowena's House of Splendors is glad to receive the custom of such individuals, and we in turn employ talented individuals such as yourself to craft or procure these collectables.

11.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_002
11.description: Compensation will be commensurate to the collectability of items provided and paid in scrips, which can be exchanged for all manner of fine wares.

12.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_003
12.description: Please note that scrips can only be obtained by Disciples of the Hand and Land level 50 and higher.

13.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_010
13.description: Quite frankly, almost anything can be considered a collectable, so long as it was crafted or procured with that intent.

14.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_011
14.description: I must warn you, however, that collectables are only valued by those who collect them. They cannot be sold to most merchants, nor can they be used as materials when crafting.

15.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_015
15.description: In lieu of gil, we compensate our collectables suppliers with scrips, which can be exchanged for all manner of fine wares.

16.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_016
16.description: These items are supplied exclusively by Rowena's House of Splendors, and we are confident that they will meet with your satisfaction.

17.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_017
17.description: To confirm the number of scrips in your possession, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Currency<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, then select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Other<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from within the interface.

18.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_020
18.description: If you wish to submit a collectable, pray present it to one of our representatives for appraisal.

19.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_021
19.description: Please be advised that we may be forced to decline your submission should it not be of sufficient collectability.

20.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_022
20.description: On the other hand, should your submission's collectability far exceed our requirements, we should be glad to give you greater compensation.

23.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_025
23.description: Crafting collectables is much like crafting anything else. The key difference, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, is the intent...

24.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_026
24.description: Collectable items can be found in the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Collectables<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> category of the Crafting Log under the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Special Recipes<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> tab. It should be noted that successful synthesis of items in this category will always yield a collectable item.

25.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_027
25.description: Increasing an item's quality through synthesis will also increase its <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>collectability<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

27.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_030
27.description: Gathering collectables is much like gathering anything else. The key difference, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, is the intent...

28.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_031
28.description: Selecting a collectable item in the gathering window as a botanist or miner will open a separate interface specific to collectable items.

29.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_032
29.description: One technique miners and botanists may employ to raise <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>collectability<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is the use of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scrutiny<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Scour<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Those confident in their skills as a gatherer are encouraged to try other combinations of skills.

30.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_033
30.description: Although Scrutiny increases collectability, it also expends a gathering attempt to do so. One must be mindful of their actions to ensure integrity still remains after reaching a suitable collectability rating.

31.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_034
31.description: While fishing under the effect of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Collector's Glove<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status, fish landed will be gathered as collectables, their size directly affecting collectability.

32.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_LYDIRLONA_000_035
32.description: Ah, well those are snippets of near-mythical local knowledge, bound together in singular volumes for the benefit of fishers and gatherers like yourself, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. Sift the fact from the fantastical, and who knows what kind of rare and valuable resources you might rediscover.

33.name: TEXT_REGLAKCOLLECTABLESUPPLYFRONT_00272_SYSTEM_000_036
33.description: By reading tomes of regional folklore, you will discover previously hidden gathering points and fishing holes, which will then be added to your gathering and fishing logs.
